summary: Sprint 2.3 'Nueva Propiedad' workspace fully verified. All 21 assertions PASS across every acceptance criterion: 6 blocks render in correct layout (left column: Información/Características/Propietario/Descripción/Fotografías/Vera Studio; right column: Health Score then Publicación), discreet top progress bar transitions 0%→13%→25%→63% completado as fields fill, Health Score becomes '80 Muy buena', publication-status flips from 'En preparación' to 'Lista para Publicar' after title+price+owner+description+5 photos, all checklist items track correctly with the last 3 marked opcional, Vera Studio empty-state → 5 stages → suggestions + detected-rooms, Owner block shows details/nextstep correctly, save/draft toasts render calm microcopy. Zero console/page errors. VERA design tokens intact.
critical_code_review_comments: assistant-service.ts: pure/deterministic assess() with clean priority ordering — nice separation of diagnosis from UI. Health formula (coreDone/5 * 80 + extrasDone/3 * 20) is transparent and testable.

OwnerSection.tsx L9-12: OWNER_OPTIONS is built at module load time by calling ownerService.listOwners(). Fine for a fully mock service but if OwnerService ever becomes async/dynamic, this frozen list will not refresh. Consider computing options inside the component with useMemo.
form-schema.ts uses string types for price/bedrooms/bathrooms/areaM2. Works for the current mock but numeric coercion + validation (positive number) would be safer before real backend wiring.

PropertyWorkspace.tsx L37-40: useMemo dep is only [values, studio.photos.length] — the full 'values' object reference changes on every keystroke due to react-hook-form watch(), so the memo effectively recomputes each render. Not a bug (assess is cheap) but the useMemo is redundant.

HealthScoreSection message can read 'Completá título y precio para avanzar.' etc. — verified microcopy stays calm and never says 'error' / 'faltan campos obligatorios'. Aligned with product philosophy.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 2.3 acceptance fully verified. Health Score formula: coreDone/5*80 + extrasDone/3*20 (5 core: datos/propietario/fotos/precio/descripcion; 3 optional: plano/video/anio). With all 5 core done and 0 optional the score = 80 → 'Muy buena', which matches the 'at least Muy buena' criterion. Photo pipeline ~4.5s, wait ≥6s after set_input_files. Photo tile count uses `[data-testid^="photo-"]` which matches 'photo-file-input' too — n photos = n+1 matches. Owner select uses native <select>, so page.select_option(value='own-1'|'own-2'|'own-3') works.
